_method_version: 3.0.0 is a MAJOR bump: a promotion audit re-derived every headline number and retracted three answers (Q23 diffusion speed by field, Q25 deadline-paper quality, Q29 dead topics). All three had read a property of the measurement as a property of the subject. Figures and rows written under 2.x are not comparable on those three questions; they are kept, not deleted. 3.0.0 also retracts a fourth answer found while charting: Q19's stated cause for the ancestry gap (a record-type effect) is wrong — it is a date cliff in OpenAlex's ingestion at 2022. Renamed from paper-to-production to hf-paper-adoption before first commit: the old slug asserted a direction the recipe partly disproves (131 of 1,133 pairs have the model first) and implied a universe of published research it does not cover.

wss-hugging-face.what: weekly capture of Hugging Face model listings and the curated daily-papers feed
wss-hugging-face.role: CAPTURE — the feed overwrites itself; without this the 2026 cohort is unreconstructable
wss-hugging-face.note: not vendored here; set $WSS_HUGGING_FACE or place it at artifacts/data/wss-hugging-face
wss-hugging-face._manifest_note: 879 feed files are hashed as one manifest of 'path size' lines, not individually: the per-file list would be longer than this document and the point is drift detection.

arxiv.what: LaTeX source of each model-cited paper, parsed for its .bbl reference list
arxiv.role: ENRICHMENT — arXiv archives permanently, so this is re-fetchable and no window closes
arxiv.refetched: 2026-09-14 — 449/449 papers, 428 yielded a .bbl, 2,014MB streamed and discarded
arxiv.drift_note: the re-fetch returned 424 usable bibliographies where the first pass had 428, and 173 citations of Attention where it had 175. Papers get revised; a .bbl is whatever the current source says. verify.py surfaces this rather than hiding it.

openalex.what: reference lists by arXiv DOI, for the backwards lineage walk
openalex.role: ENRICHMENT — re-fetchable; 86% resolve but only 24% carry references

verify: python artifacts/scripts/verify.py — re-derives every number above from the capture

figures.why: 20's evidence was never stored; 26's data lives outside this recipe; 37 is an absence.
